# Safsafah (صفصافه)

> Safsafah is a Saudi Arabian e-commerce platform specializing in premium cosmetics, skincare, and beauty products. The site supports both Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR) and ships across Saudi Arabia.

## Site Overview

- **Domain:** https://safsafah.com
- **Languages:** Arabic (default, RTL), English
- **Category:** Beauty & Cosmetics E-commerce
- **Currency:** SAR (Saudi Riyal)

## Key Pages

- **Homepage:** https://safsafah.com — Featured collections, best sellers, top brands, and categories
- **Catalog / Shop:** https://safsafah.com/catalog — Browse all products with filters (brand, category, price, skin type)
- **Product Page:** https://safsafah.com/product/{slug} — Full product detail, images, description, reviews, and add-to-cart
- **Cart:** https://safsafah.com/cart — Shopping cart with quantity controls and coupon codes
- **Checkout:** https://safsafah.com/checkout — Delivery address (with map picker), payment methods, order summary
- **Brands:** https://safsafah.com/brands — Browse all available beauty brands
- **Blog:** https://safsafah.com/blog — Beauty tips, skincare guides, and product tutorials
- **Contact:** https://safsafah.com/contact — Customer support contact form and response hours
- **Login:** https://safsafah.com/login — Email/password or OTP login
- **Sign Up:** https://safsafah.com/signup — New account registration
- **My Account:** https://safsafah.com/account — Order history, addresses, wishlist, rewards wallet, beauty profile, settings
- **My Orders:** https://safsafah.com/orders — Track and manage past orders
- **Skin Quiz:** https://safsafah.com/quize — Personalized skin type and concern quiz to get product recommendations
- **Wallet Payment:** https://safsafah.com/wallet-payment — Pay using Safsafah rewards wallet

## Product Categories

Safsafah carries products in the following beauty categories:
- Skincare (moisturizers, serums, cleansers, toners, masks, SPF)
- Makeup (foundation, lipstick, mascara, eyeshadow, blush, concealer)
- Haircare (shampoo, conditioner, hair masks, oils)
- Fragrance & Body (perfumes, body lotions, scrubs)
- Tools & Accessories (brushes, applicators, devices)
- Men's Grooming

## Key Features

- **Beauty Profile / Skin Quiz:** Users can take a skin type quiz to receive personalized product recommendations
- **Rewards Wallet:** Loyalty points earned on purchases, redeemable at checkout
- **Wishlist:** Save products for later
- **Reviews & Ratings:** Product reviews with rating breakdown
- **Bilingual:** Full Arabic and English support with locale-based routing (`/ar/`, `/en/`)
- **Fast Delivery:** Ships across Saudi Arabia

## Common User Actions

- Search and filter products by brand, category, skin type, or price
- Add products to cart and proceed to checkout
- Apply coupon codes
- Select delivery address using an interactive map
- Pay via card or Safsafah wallet
- Track existing orders
- Save items to wishlist
- Write and read product reviews
- Take the skin quiz for personalized recommendations
- Contact support

## Contact & Support

- Contact page: https://safsafah.com/contact
- Social media links available in site footer
